big_story.headline: India-EU FTA: The Mother of All Deals
big_story.subhead: INDIA AND THE EU ARE LIKELY TO SIGN A LANDMARK TRADE PACT IN DECEMBER
paragraphs: India and the European Union are poised to sign a landmark Free Trade Agreement in December, described by officials as the mother of all deals. The pact is expected to come into force by mid-2027, unlocking vast commercial opportunities across sectors. Negotiations have reached their final stages as both sides aim to expand bilateral commerce and foster long-term economic integration.

The upcoming agreement aims to streamline cross-border trade, lower tariffs, and facilitate cross-border corporate mergers and acquisitions. With S&P Global projecting India’s economy to grow 7% in FY27 and FY28, the trade deal comes at a pivotal moment for domestic manufacturers and service providers. Industry leaders expect the framework to drive job creation and enhance India's position in global supply chains.

As momentum builds ahead of the expected December signing, businesses on both sides are evaluating regulatory shifts and tariff reductions. Analysts note that while implementation may take until mid-2027, the strategic alignment between India and the EU will spark increased foreign direct investment. Market participants will be closely watching the final text to assess sector-specific impacts.
big_story.pullbox: The proposed India-EU Free Trade Agreement promises to reshape bilateral commerce by cutting tariffs and unlocking cross-border investment, anchoring India's targeted 7% annual economic growth trajectory.

explains.title: What is a Free Trade Agreement?
paragraphs: A Free Trade Agreement is a treaty between two or more countries to reduce or eliminate barriers to trade, such as tariffs, quotas, and administrative delays. By encouraging seamless movement of goods and services across borders, FTAs help member nations expand market access for their exports.

In practice, an FTA lowers import duties on designated products, making foreign goods cheaper for consumers while allowing domestic firms to compete globally. Beyond physical merchandise, modern trade pacts also address intellectual property, investment flows, and cross-border regulatory standards.

Indian data security startup Matters.AI has secured ₹115 crore ($12m) in a pre-Series A funding round to enhance its cybersecurity offerings. The startup focuses on safeguarding sensitive enterprise data against emerging cyber threats in an increasingly digital business ecosystem.

The capital injection comes amid rising demand for advanced data protection solutions across enterprise and financial sectors. Matters.AI plans to utilize the fresh capital to expand its engineering team, scale product architecture, and accelerate adoption across domestic and global markets.

story_1.headline: India Inc Rushes to Raise $2.7B Debt Ahead of RBI Rate Hike
paragraphs: Indian conglomerates and corporate borrowers are rushing to issue bonds and secure bank lines to raise $2.7 billion in debt. The fundraising blitz comes amid growing expectations of an upcoming interest rate hike by the Reserve Bank of India.
State Bank of India noted that a 25 basis point rate increase may be sufficient to curb inflationary pressures, cautioning the central bank against aggressive calls for a jumbo 50 basis point hike.

story_2.headline: CrowdStrike Buys Zscaler in Massive Cyber Deal
paragraphs: Cybersecurity giant CrowdStrike has announced an acquisition of Zscaler in a major transaction reshaping the enterprise software landscape. The deal marks one of the largest strategic buyouts in the cloud security sector this year.
The transaction is set to boost the wealth of IIT BHU graduate Jay Chaudhry by ₹1.39 lakh crore, highlighting the significant valuation premiums attached to zero-trust architecture pioneers.

story_3.headline: S&P Global Projects 7% Growth for India in FY27 and FY28
paragraphs: S&P Global has projected India's economy to grow at a steady rate of 7% in FY27 and FY28. The credit rating agency cited strong domestic demand and sustained industrial output as key pillars supporting the medium-term expansion.

geopolitics.headline: India Seals Key Aid Deal With Nepal's Rapper-Turned-PM
paragraphs: Nepal's rapper-turned-Prime Minister has officially sealed a new aid deal with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The strategic pact underscores New Delhi's neighbourhood-first diplomacy as India deepens bilateral cooperation with its Himalayan neighbour. The deal arrives as South Asian economies focus on strengthening cross-border infrastructure and economic connectivity.

While specific financial commitments in the bilateral agreement continue to unfold, the aid pact reinforces regional stability and supply chain integration. For Indian enterprises operating across the border, solid diplomatic footing ensures reduced trade friction and secures strategic transit corridors in the region.

big_story.headline: India Needs $2 Billion Yearly Investment to Boost Space Economy
big_story.text: A new report highlights that India requires an annual investment of $2 billion to expand its global space economy share. Strengthening private sector participation and capital inflow into space technology is vital for the nation to compete with global spacefaring leaders and build domestic satellite infrastructure.

big_story.headline: Dynacons Systems Reports 56% YoY Revenue Jump to ₹551 Crore
big_story.text: Dynacons Systems & Solutions reported a 56% year-on-year increase in revenue to ₹551 crore for Q2FY27. The strong revenue surge highlights expanding demand for IT infrastructure and digital transformation services across Indian enterprises, signaling robust corporate technology spending.

venture_vault.headline: Ionic Wealth Secures ₹177 Crore Led by Angel One
venture_vault.text: Fintech platform Ionic Wealth has raised ₹177 crore in a strategic funding round led by retail brokerage firm Angel One. The capital infusion underscores growing investor interest in Indian wealthtech solutions aimed at catering to retail investors seeking automated asset management.

venture_vault.headline: SatSure Raises $7 Million from Sovereign Space Fund
venture_vault.text: Bengaluru-based spacetech startup SatSure has raised $7 million in funding from a sovereign space fund. The capital injection will help the firm scale its earth observation data analytics capabilities, supporting critical agricultural and financial decision-making processes across India.

geopolitics.headline: US-India Trade Deal Faces Nicotine Pouch Ban Hurdle
geopolitics.text: Negotiations over a trade deal between the US under Donald Trump and India hit a potential snag over a proposed ban on nicotine pouches. Resolving regulatory hurdles remains crucial as both nations seek to expand bilateral commercial ties and deepen economic cooperation amidst shifting global trade dynamics.

geopolitics.headline: India-EU Trade Pact Expected to Be Signed on December 16
geopolitics.text: India and the European Union are set to sign their long-negotiated free trade agreement on December 16. The comprehensive pact aims to significantly lower tariffs and boost trade flows between the two economies, serving as a landmark milestone for Indian exporters seeking expanded European market access.
